summary: T14 implementation conforms to the saved plan: scripts/first_run_smoke.py adds installer-fixture, installer-release, tool-install, source-tool-install, and source-uv-run lanes with local default execution, explicit release gating, isolated uv/pipx tool homes and bin dirs, source checkout copying, outside-cwd source proofs, and concise CLI reporting. Focused unit and integration tests cover fixture dry-run wiring, release gating, env isolation, source copy behavior, source no-global execution, and source tool install execution. The validation artifact records the targeted pytest, ruff, format, and harness smoke evidence while correctly deferring broad AWF/GitHub validation.
